description: Yandex watch counter identity plus optional pinned-runtime advice for page-url, charset and JSON site-info. Runtime fields are guarded by browser-info presence; counter-only image hits remain supported. Query, form and bodyless transports retain their source behavior. Receiver law, session state and arbitrary custom data stay open.

params.name: counter_id
params.description: It is the numeric Metrica tag ID. Yandex documents the counter as `/watch/{counter_id}`.
params.fix_hint: Put the tag ID from the Metrica interface in the path as `/watch/{id}`.

params.name: browser-info
params.description: Nonempty browser-info gates the optional runtime defaults. It is a profile hint, not proof of producer identity, a closed flag grammar or a required noscript field.

params.name: page-url
params.description: Pinned prepareUrl uses String.slice with a 2048 UTF-16-unit cap, or 512 on IE. The broad 2048 cap uses exact code-unit counting but cannot enforce the lower IE cap without browser context. Custom schemes and empty values remain open.

params.name: charset
params.description: Optional default-producer advice: senderWatchInfo emits utf-8. This does not establish receiver-wide encoding law, field requiredness or restrictions on custom middleware.

params.name: site-info
params.description: Optional serialized JSON visit parameters can arrive in URL or form fallback fields. All JSON root types and arbitrary custom members remain open. Blank, macro and cross-carrier ambiguity follow existing input behavior.
Decode JSON syntax only. No root type, custom-member schema, null ban or scalar format is imposed.
